Codex review: needs changes before merge. ## What this changes This PR migrates shared link readers, file previews, and media lightboxes from Lit to Solid while retaining their registered tags and interaction contracts. **Example:** Open src/viewer.ts in the shared file preview. - **Before:** Lit renders the file list, source contents, Copy action, and keyboard controls. - **After:** Solid renders those controls through the existing openclaw-file-preview-modal tag. ## Review scores | Measure | Result | What it means | |---|---|---| | **Overall readiness** | 🦐 gold shrimp **(3/6)** | Useful migration with inspected component proof and passing checks, held by one concrete keyboard dismissal defect. | | **Proof confidence** | 🦐 gold shrimp **(3/6)** ✨ media proof bonus | Sufficient (screenshot): Supplied Chrome fixtures exercise the migrated production viewer components with synthetic inputs; inspected before/after screenshots cover reader, file preview, lightbox, hovercard, and shadow-root presentation, while CI supports interaction coverage without proving the newly identified mounting case. | | **Patch quality** | 🦐 gold shrimp **(3/6)** | 1 actionable review finding remain. | ## Product **Kind:** Refactor · **Worth it:** Yes · **Fix scope:** Complete **User problem:** Existing shared viewers must retain their interactions as the Control UI adopts Solid. **Reason:** The established migration direction preserves current viewer capabilities and keeps transport ownership intact without introducing settings or public plugin API changes. ## Merge readiness ⛔ **Needs changes before merge - 1 item remains** Keep this PR open: it advances the approved Solid migration, but the latest focus-recovery change can leave keyboard hovercards stuck open. **Priority:** P2 **Reviewed head:** `5a23a721f26774dccdf4856e1385b86014b42a86` ## Before merge - [ ] **Recover focused anchors with keyboard intent (P2)** - When an already-registered provider is appended and its anchor is focused before the bridge's mounting microtask, this recovery calls activateFocusedAnchor, which always activates with trigger "pointer" and the hover delay. That sets hovercard.pointerInside=true although the pointer never entered the anchor. Moving focus to an outside control clears only focusInside, so PortaledHovercardController.scheduleClose sees the card as held and leaves it open; moving focus away before the delay can also allow a late card to appear. The existing keyboard-exit tests await mounting before focusing and miss this path. Recover through the focus activation rules, including the ordinary-page focus-visible check, and extend the dismissal regression to focus before mounting without pointer events. ## Findings - [P2] Recover focused anchors with keyboard intent — `ui/src/components/link-reader-hovercard-owner.ts:287-290` ### Tests - Missing end-to-end proof: The supplied component captures do not exercise pre-mount keyboard focus followed by leaving the recovered hovercard.
Agent review details ### How this fits together Control UI callers supply documents, files, and media to registered viewers; existing owners manage requests and resource lifetimes while Solid presents content and dispatches interactions. ```mermaid flowchart LR A[Chat and sidebar callers] --> B[Registered viewer bridges] B --> C[Viewer state owners] C --> D[Gateway and media loaders] D --> C C --> E[Solid viewer content] E --> F[User interactions] F --> C ``` ### Technical review Best possible solution: Preserve the single-renderer migration and recover pre-mount focus through the existing keyboard-intent and dismissal rules. Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue? Source establishes the failure when an already-registered provider is appended and its link receives focus before the bridge mounts; no target code was executed during this read-only review. Is this the best way to solve the issue? The migration uses the established bridge and preserves request owners, but recovered focus must retain its actual trigger instead of fabricating pointer intent. Full review comments: - [P2] Recover focused anchors with keyboard intent — `ui/src/components/link-reader-hovercard-owner.ts:287-290` When an already-registered provider is appended and its anchor is focused before the bridge's mounting microtask, this recovery calls activateFocusedAnchor, which always activates with trigger "pointer" and the hover delay. That sets hovercard.pointerInside=true although the pointer never entered the anchor. Moving focus to an outside control clears only focusInside, so PortaledHovercardController.scheduleClose sees the card as held and leaves it open; moving focus away before the delay can also allow a late card to appear. The existing keyboard-exit tests await mounting before focusing and miss this path. Recover through the focus activation rules, including the ordinary-page focus-visible check, and extend the dismissal regression to focus before mounting without pointer events. Confidence: 0.99 Overall correctness: patch is incorrect Overall confidence: 0.98 AGENTS.md: found and applied where relevant. Codex review notes: model internal, reasoning medium; reviewed against [fc0720162ede](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/fc0720162ede7718b7b3ce6af28da9fc41cbc8f8). ### Provenance checked - `Shared bridge` keeps the original intent (eca633a8801b0b884d88fe65e7096a4760102b83: Bridge remaining Lit callers to one Solid implementation while preserving properties, caller content, context, and lifecycle timing.) - `Link reader and hover ownership` keeps the original intent (https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/148464: Present read-only documents beside chat while keeping transport and caller authority with their existing owners.) - `Image viewer` keeps the original intent (0226ad50fac70e3dd428ad3f674a12af539f92b0: Present already-authorized media through the shared modal while retaining focus and source lifetimes.) - `Skill-bundle file viewer` keeps the original intent (a11a431e380ff7272b8deee44f494e16a9de6692: Browse complete skill bundles with relative document navigation and consumer-specific controls.) ### Testing Proof path: in-process harness. ### Security None. ### Evidence Acceptance criteria: - pnpm test ui/src/components/link-reader-hovercard-interactions.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 - pnpm test ui/src/components/link-reader-hovercard-seeds.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 - pnpm test ui/src/app/native-link-routing.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 - git diff --check What I checked: - **Approved migration contract:** The UI policy requires Solid migration, synchronous domain owners, and one implementation per registered tag; the change follows that established direction. ([`ui/AGENTS.md:5`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/5a23a721f26774dccdf4856e1385b86014b42a86/ui/AGENTS.md#L5), [5a23a721f267](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5a23a721f26774dccdf4856e1385b86014b42a86)) - **New focus-recovery defect:** The latest commit invokes a pointer-intent helper for an already-focused anchor after mounting, setting pointerInside without a pointer event. ([`ui/src/components/link-reader-hovercard-owner.ts:290`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/5a23a721f26774dccdf4856e1385b86014b42a86/ui/src/components/link-reader-hovercard-owner.ts#L290), [5a23a721f267](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5a23a721f26774dccdf4856e1385b86014b42a86)) - **Dismissal causal chain:** Focus-out clears focusInside only; the portal's held predicate still sees pointerInside, so scheduleClose returns without dismissing the recovered card. ([`ui/src/components/portaled-hovercard.ts:137`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/5a23a721f26774dccdf4856e1385b86014b42a86/ui/src/components/portaled-hovercard.ts#L137), [5a23a721f267](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5a23a721f26774dccdf4856e1385b86014b42a86)) - **Existing coverage misses the mounting case:** Keyboard dismissal tests await provider.updateComplete before focusing, bypassing the new recovery path. ([`ui/src/components/link-reader-hovercard-interactions.test.ts:533`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/5a23a721f26774dccdf4856e1385b86014b42a86/ui/src/components/link-reader-hovercard-interactions.test.ts#L533), [5a23a721f267](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5a23a721f26774dccdf4856e1385b86014b42a86)) - **Prior fixes and validation:** Containing-root hit testing, reactive translations, inherited theme tokens, light-DOM queries, and connected-child adoption are present; CI run https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/38131082563 completed successfully on the reviewed head, resolving the previous check blocker.
